links.outcome: Whether the AI recognized a safety-critical situation and escalated to emergency services
links.effect: In a single case, the generative AI issued a clear imperative to contact emergency services. The patient then activated emergency care, was diagnosed with inferior STEMI, and underwent successful PCI.
links.quote: After consulting a publicly available generative AI system that issued a clear imperative to contact emergency medical services, the patient activated emergency care.

screen.reason: Single-patient case report documenting real-world patient use of a generative AI tool to overcome normalcy bias and seek emergency care for acute myocardial infarction.
